description:
Video Edit tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- apply_video_edit: Video-to-video edit of an existing clip.
- apply_reshoot: Doppelganger edits ONE existing video using reference images, as the signed-in user.
- restyle_video: Redraw ONE video (3-30 s) in a named look (claymation, anime, pixel art, yarn, toy CGI, painterly 3D, gouache, comic…), keeping its motion, 
- multiply_ad: Ad Multiplier: ONE ad clip -> 2-12 variants, one per row; each row swaps product, person, location or outfit for its own 1-4 reference image
- upscale_video: Submit an asynchronous video upscale job as the signed-in user.
- motion_control: Motion work on an existing shot, selected by `mode`.
- motion_recast: Plan or execute a camera-motion recast.
- generate_frame_interpolation: Generate in-between STILL frames from two keyframes (one AI image edit per in-between frame).
- analyze_video: Analyze a video (URL) with Gemini 2.5 Pro and return a scene-by-scene breakdown: shot type, camera motion, lighting, subjects, dialogue, and
- clip_long_video: Turn a long video into N short-form clips.
- dub_video: Translate a video or voiceover into another language in one step.
- apply_speed_ramp: Speed-ramp an existing clip on our ffmpeg (no model): eased ramps, motion-interpolated slow motion, tearing-checked.
- apply_deflicker: Remove AI brightness flicker on our ffmpeg: several settings are measured and the best one that keeps >= 95 % sharpness ships; never a clip

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).

name: video_edit
title: Video Edit
